== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes use this skill without considering the condition for the energy return. As such, they may waste energy by using it on allies with greater than 50% health.

== Notes ==
* Out of all the monk spells, this spell is capable of healing the most health in a single [[packet]] unconditionally.

== Trivia ==
* Zealous Benediction shares the animation cast on its target with [[Word of Healing]], a Healing Prayers skill it loosely mimics in usage.
* This skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
